Research note: The requested page redirected to the Anakin Skywalker (Legends) article. The article was scrolled to its end; the tail reached “Notes and references” and the external-links material. Entries below are sentences copied from the article, with its section names and citation markers retained. “Statement, not feat” marks hype, scaling, or character/editorial opinion rather than an observed feat.

LEAD / BIOGRAPHY
- “Skywalker exhibited exceptional piloting skills and a reputation for being able to build and repair anything even at a young age.” [lead, statement]
  Source: UNSOURCED on Wookieepedia (sentence found in "Anakin Skywalker/Legends" rev 15723061 but it has no inline citation in its paragraph; exact text match)
- “Vader and Kenobi clashed on Mustafar after Vader attacked his wife in the belief that she had betrayed him, and the newly christened Sith Lord was left limbless and ravaged by fire at the end of their battle.” [lead]
  Source: UNSOURCED on Wookieepedia (sentence found in "Anakin Skywalker/Legends" rev 15723061 but it has no inline citation in its paragraph; exact text match)
- “Encased in a suit of life-sustaining black armor and believing his wife to be dead, Vader embraced his role as the Emperor's right hand, hunting down Jedi survivors, crushing Separatist holdouts and ensuring the fulfillment of ‘his’ Empire's policies for years to come, actions that awarded him special powers and ultimately the position of Supreme Commander of Imperial Forces.” [lead]
  Source: UNSOURCED on Wookieepedia (sentence found in "Anakin Skywalker/Legends" rev 15723061 but it has no inline citation in its paragraph; exact text match)
- “In a final duel on the second Death Star as the Battle of Endor raged around them, Skywalker and Vader fought each other, and Vader refused his son's attempts to redeem him, learning that Skywalker had a twin sister named Leia in the process.” [lead]
  Source: UNSOURCED on Wookieepedia (sentence found in "Anakin Skywalker/Legends" rev 15723061 but it has no inline citation in its paragraph; exact text match)
- “Skywalker defeated his father but refused to kill him, and when Sidious attempted to kill the young man, Vader—moved by his son's love—abandoned the dark side and sacrificed himself to destroy the Emperor, fulfilling the prophecy of the Chosen One.” [lead]
  Source: UNSOURCED on Wookieepedia (sentence found in "Anakin Skywalker/Legends" rev 15723061 but it has no inline citation in its paragraph; exact text match)

EARLY LIFE / JEDI APPRENTICE
- “At an early age, Skywalker exhibited signs of Force-sensitivity; he could sense things before they happened, occasionally sensed the emotions of others, and had exceptional piloting skills which Watto put to use when he made the child race his podracer at age six[39]—the first Human to survive and excel at the sport.” [Life as a slave]
  Source: Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith novelization ; Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace novelization [per Wookieepedia "Anakin Skywalker/Legends" rev 15723061, ref 39,40; exact text match; agrees with the entry's own ref marker]
- “In 32 BBY, Skywalker encountered the Jedi Qui-Gon Jinn and Padmé Amidala, and he helped them secure the parts they needed for their starship by winning the Boonta Eve Classic podracing event—only to learn that he had also won his freedom in doing so.” [lead]
  Source: UNSOURCED on Wookieepedia (sentence found in "Anakin Skywalker/Legends" rev 15723061 but it has no inline citation in its paragraph; exact text match)
- “Ultimately, Skywalker fought in the Battle of Naboo in a vicious starfighter battle above the planet.” [The Battle of Naboo]
  Source: Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace [per Wookieepedia "Anakin Skywalker/Legends" rev 15723061, ref 5; exact text match]
- “After accidentally joining the battle in orbit, Skywalker single-handedly destroyed the orbital Droid Control Ship from within the ship, moments after Lt. Gavyn Sykes destroyed the deflector shield generator, thus rendering the Trade Federation's ground forces inactive and saving the Gungan Grand Army from destruction.” [The Battle of Naboo]
  Source: Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace [per Wookieepedia "Anakin Skywalker/Legends" rev 15723061, ref 5; exact text match]
- “Anakin igniting his lightsaber to battle the entity until it uses the Force to destroy his lightsaber and blasts him with Force lightning.” [Duel in the Jedi Council Chambers]
  Source: "Temple of Phantoms" — Star Wars Comic 7.9 [per Wookieepedia "Anakin Skywalker/Legends" rev 15723061, ref 55; exact text match]
- “Despite the loss of his saber, Anakin manages to defeat the entity and Tiplee and Obi-Wan found him unconscious where it was revealed to be a vision.” [Duel in the Jedi Council Chambers]
  Source: "Temple of Phantoms" — Star Wars Comic 7.9 [per Wookieepedia "Anakin Skywalker/Legends" rev 15723061, ref 55; exact text match]
- “When Ke Daiv, now Tarkin's bodyguard, attempted to kill Skywalker, the boy, in a fit of uncontrollable rage, telekinetically burned the Blood Carver from the inside out—it was Anakin's ‘first personal kill.’” [Zonama Sekot]
  Source: Rogue Planet [per Wookieepedia "Anakin Skywalker/Legends" rev 15723061, ref 53; exact text match]
- “Using his training lightsaber, Skywalker aided his master in battling the gorgodons… Skywalker was able to climb the creature's back and, after a momentary struggle, to stab the beast with his training lightsaber at a vulnerable point in the gorgodon's neck, killing it.” [Crafting a lightsaber]
